consumer: mission::is_complete for MGOAL_FIND_ITEM, asking the yes/no 'does the player hold the required package quantity to turn in the mission' that the engine evaluates to gate turn-in
scope: the player's full crafting_inventory() reach (carried plus nearby reachable items), not only on-person carried items
decisive_source: src/mission.cpp::mission::is_complete (MGOAL_FIND_ITEM) -- checks u.crafting_inventory().has_amount/has_charges(type->item_id, item_count) and returns the boolean that decides mission completeness
divergence: the required package sits in a reachable container/vehicle/ground tile within crafting reach but is not worn or carried: crafting_inventory() counts it so the mission is completable, but a carried-items-only answer (Excerpt 2 reach) falsely reports the player cannot turn it in
